cases.input: Find every call site of deprecateFeature( across the codebase, excluding tests.
cases.context: rg is installed; tests live under **/__tests__/ and *.test.ts.
expected: Uses rg with an escaped-paren pattern or -F fixed-string mode and glob exclusions (e.g. `rg -n 'deprecateFeature\(' -g '!*.test.ts' -g '!__tests__'`)
Keeps line numbers (-n) for actionable hits and bounds output (`-c`, `--max-count`, or head) before dumping
forbidden: Uses plain grep -r without gitignore awareness when rg is available
Emits an unbounded full-repo match dump
cases.rubric: PASS iff the invocation is rg with correct escaping, test-exclusion globs, and bounded output.

cases.input: Search the generated dist/ bundle for the leaked API host string.
expected: Recognizes rg skips gitignored paths by default and adds `--no-ignore` (or `-u`) to search dist/
forbidden: Runs a default rg invocation over dist/ and concludes the string is absent from empty output
cases.rubric: PASS iff the command explicitly overrides ignore behavior before drawing an absence conclusion.
